description:
Fetch the list of seller offers for an Amazon product: every merchant selling the item with their price, shipping cost, condition (new/used), fulfillment type (FBA/FBM), and seller rating. Also returns the Buy Box winner. This is the tool for competitive price analysis, reseller monitoring, and availability tracking.

Use this tool when the question is about WHO sells the product and at WHAT price. If you need the product's own details (title, images, rating), use get_product_detail instead.

Each requested page costs 1 credit. Start with a single page (default) and only increase max_page if the user needs the full offer list. Use the condition and shipping filters to narrow results instead of paginating; it is cheaper.

To see what a shopper at a specific location sees (price, availability, delivery date), pass the inline address fields (zip_code, or city/district/country_code where the domain needs them); no setup is needed. A new location is saved to the account and counts once against the plan's address limit; repeat requests for the same location reuse it. Requests with inline address fields can take up to 45 seconds. Check applied_address in the response: if it does not contain the values you sent, the address was not applied.

address_id.description: ID of an Active saved address for the same domain, from https://app.easyparser.com/addresses. Only use it when the user gives an address ID. For a ZIP code or city, use the inline fields instead. Inline fields override address_id.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number, a 10-character alphanumeric product identifier (e.g. B0CJB6V2L5). Found in the product URL after /dp/ or /gp/product/.

city.description: Inline delivery address: city. Only for .com.au (with zip_code, e.g. 'KEW'), .ae (with district, e.g. 'Abu Dhabi'), .sa and .eg (alone, one of Amazon's delivery cities, e.g. 'Riyadh'). Do not send it on other domains.

condition.description: Filter offers by item condition. Omit to include all conditions.

country_code.description: Inline delivery address: destination country for cross-border delivery as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'GB' on .com). On .nl only 'NL' or 'BE'.

district.description: Inline delivery address: area within city. Only on .ae, together with city (e.g. 'ADCO Compound').

domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain extension. Determines the regional Amazon site the data is fetched from. Use the domain that matches the user's market, because prices, availability and rankings differ across marketplaces.

free_shipping.description: If true, return only offers with free shipping.

max_page.description: Ending page number. Each page costs 1 credit; max 5 pages per request. Default 1.

prime.description: If true, return only Prime-eligible offers.

zip_code.description: Inline delivery address: ZIP or postal code, so prices, availability and delivery dates match a shopper at that location. Examples: '10001' on .com, 'SW1A 1AA' on .co.uk. Join two-part codes with a comma: 'N0E,1Y0' on .ca, '01310,100' on .com.br, '241,0014' on .co.jp. On .com.au send it with city.

name: get_product_offers

applied_address.description: Delivery address the request used (zipCode array, city, district, country_code). Without address fields this is the marketplace default.

credits_remaining.description: Credits left on the account after this request.

data.description: Parsed Amazon data for the operation.

operation.description: Easyparser operation that ran, e.g. DETAIL or OFFER.

request_id.description: Easyparser request ID, useful for support and error logs.
